reply_text:
I posted the ticket list as a reply to Nadia's message in #strategic-pod. It covers three Vantorre Group tickets, plus one possible fourth that I couldn't confirm. Each has its source.

- **#8841 (also written #PD-8841):** it appears in the pod channel on 2026-07-01 and in the 4/27, 5/4 and 9/30 Strategic digests. The sources disagree on site (Allentown vs Newark), symptom and status (open in May, closed Jul 1, "submitted" Sep 30). I couldn't tell whether it's one ticket reused or a number mix-up, so I told Nadia to check it in the ticket system before it goes to Mateo.
- **INC-4821:** #inc-vtg-hartford, Gideon, 2026-08-03. The status-page screenshot is attached to it.
- **VT-55120:** #inc-vtg-hartford, Gideon, 2026-10-14. It's the root-cause ticket for the Hartford kiosk outage. I haven't opened it myself.
- **#PD-4418 (unconfirmed):** the 2025-09-15 digest says it came from "the account Nadia runs" but doesn't name the account, so I didn't count it.

I left out Vantorre Mobility's #4812. The other Strategic digests and the cheat sheet mention Vantorre Group but give no ticket numbers.

Nadia is a member of both channels, and the digests are public files. I can only see the channels and digests, not the ticket system, so this isn't a verified full history and statuses may be out of date.
